name: Ojou-sama no Hima Tsubushi
source:
A rich girl and her maid pass the time on her big boring estate.
You have recently been hired as a cleaner, but your duties are hindered by the rich girl who sees you and instructs you to play with her.
Thus begins your ecchi "himatsubushi game", or time-wasting game. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130911.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个富家女和她的女仆在她无聊的大庄园里消磨时光。
你最近被聘为清洁工，但你的职责受到了一位富家女孩的阻碍，她看到了你并指示你和她一起玩。
这样就开始了你的ecchi“himatsubushi游戏”，或者说浪费时间的游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE130911.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
